work.author: GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS
work.description: Bull CXXVII (GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS LF28004) dismembers the province of Guayaquil from Cuenca and erects the see of Guayaquil, suffragan of Lima, with chapter, seminary and tax, executor the bishop of Quito; across own provenance LF28041, page numbers LF28044, LF28110, LF28402, running titles LF28182, LF28468, LF28539, and the page-191 head furniture LF28322–28331 (marks i and >, ANNO MDCCCXXXVII., page number 1gI; raw heading line-00028322); complete closing dated quarto kalendas februarii 1837 = 29 January 1837. No sub-scriptions are printed. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS at LF28004–28004; the source closing at LF28551–28554 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum anno incarnationis dominicae millesimo octingente- simo trigesimo septimo, quarto kalendas februa- rli, pontificatus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
